title: Wazuh or OSSEC: Open-Source Host Intrusion Detection
excerpt: Wazuh started as a fork of OSSEC and has grown into a broader open-source security platform. OSSEC is the original host-based intrusion detection system. Here is how they compare for new deployments.
verdict: Wazuh is the better choice for most new projects, thanks to active development, its own indexer and dashboard and wider integrations. OSSEC is still acceptable where an existing, stable deployment is doing its job.

spec1.label: Active development
spec1.device1Value: A younger fork with very active development
spec1.device2Value: The original project, now developing more slowly

spec2.label: Dashboards and analysis
spec2.device1Value: Ships with its own indexer and web dashboard for visual analysis
spec2.device2Value: Needs manual integration with external analysis tools

spec3.label: Starting a new project
spec3.device2Value: Older documentation and a smaller active community
